svg.text: Where California proposes to cut, and where it gives up
8,972 harvest-plan polygons, 2026-09-04. Each dot is one polygon, sized by acres.
No basemap — the plans trace the state's timber country themselves.
Generalised server-side to ~22 m; median 9 vertices.
Two populations, not one: Proposed is the live pipeline
(141 of 149 filed 2025-26); Withdrawn is a back-catalogue
reaching 2015. A ratio between them means nothing.
each dot is one polygon, sized by its share of the plan's acres
